item.title: Pint X (7314 / Hydrus 5200) — Best Path to More Range Before VESC?
item.description: If you open up your battery box you’ll see the BMS has 4 different cables going into it. The smallest one that sticks out perpendicular to the PCB is what lets your BMS tell your ESC that your board is charging. If you unplug it, it has no way of knowing so you can charge your board as you ride if you get a backpack setup This might break FM firmware as well, I can’t be completely sure.
